server.name: me.openbrowser/openbrowser-ai
server.description: AI browser automation. Write async Python to navigate, click, type, and extract data.

environmentVariables.description: Run browser in headless mode (true/false)
environmentVariables.name: OPENBROWSER_HEADLESS

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated list of allowed domains (empty for no restrictions)
environmentVariables.name: OPENBROWSER_ALLOWED_DOMAINS

environmentVariables.description: Chrome profile directory for persistent browser sessions
environmentVariables.name: OPENBROWSER_USER_DATA_DIR

environmentVariables.description: JSON file used to save and restore cookies plus localStorage between MCP restarts
environmentVariables.name: OPENBROWSER_STORAGE_STATE

environmentVariables.description: Use minimal tool description (~500 tokens instead of ~1,430)
environmentVariables.name: OPENBROWSER_COMPACT_DESCRIPTION

environmentVariables.description: Maximum output characters per code execution (default: 10000)
environmentVariables.name: OPENBROWSER_MAX_OUTPUT

environmentVariables.description: Enable anonymized usage telemetry (true/false)
environmentVariables.name: ANONYMIZED_TELEMETRY
